Property Description:
One room for rent in a shared house 

A large 1920's residence located in the Mission District near the Zuckerberg Hospital. Located on Utah Street between 23 and 24th near grocery markets, taquerias, etc.

Upstairs features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 shared bathrooms, large Kitchen is remodeled and includes oven, stove, dishwasher, and fridge. One Bedroom available for rent has a closet and a window facing the backyard, where there are orange and plum trees and lots of opportunity for gardening or just hanging out. Currently there are three tenants upstairs  so it’s a shared space.

It includes a indoor laundry with washer/dryer (not coin operated).

Nearest bus stops are 9, 10, 33, 48 and it's a 15-20 minute walk to Mission Bart.
